registered funds' cash Treasury 10-year equivalents (the cash build's survivors and fixed curve), split by the Form N-CEN index flag

The split of registered funds' cash Treasury duration change between series flagged 'Index Fund' on Form N-CEN (any index, not only Treasury indexes) and the rest is not established: the index-flag share of the classified change was 67.6% in 2024, 52.2% in 2025 and 41.4% in the first half of 2026, against 56.9% of the classified stock at end-2023. The share in the first half of 2026 was neither at least 60% with the required margins nor at most 40% and no higher than the stock share, so it falls between the two bars.
0.15 is a pre-registered hurdle taken from a different object (the funds' excess over the public stock in the cash build) after that object was measured; it is not a sampling bound
